title: When and how to contact support

summary.text: Support works through the support portal at https://daedalus.support.se7enlabs.com. Open a case when the help article for your problem did not solve it, when Daedalus asks you to submit a support request, or when a receiving address in Daedalus differs from the one your hardware wallet shows.

problem.text: A user needs help from a person and wants to know when to open a support case and where to ask.

symptoms.text: The user cannot solve the problem with the FAQ.

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.0 release notes and the 11.6.0 tag source. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

resolutions.action: Open the support portal: in Daedalus, select Support Request in the Help menu, or go to https://daedalus.support.se7enlabs.com.
resolutions.why: The Help menu item opens the support portal.

resolutions.action: Verify your email address when the portal asks.
resolutions.why: The portal asks for email verification once before support starts.

resolutions.action: Try the support guidance the portal offers first.
resolutions.why: The portal offers approved Daedalus Wallet support guidance before a human case.

resolutions.action: If you still need help, continue to a human support case and describe the problem.
resolutions.why: The portal prepares a human support case when guidance did not help.

resolutions.action: In Daedalus, select Download Logs in the Help menu, then attach the file to your case.
resolutions.why: Daedalus asks for the downloaded logs to be attached to a support request.

expected_outcome.text: The portal's guidance solves the problem, or you have a support case, which you can return to later with Open an existing case.

do_not: Do not put your recovery phrase, spending password or private keys in a support case. Support never asks for them.

evidence.rationale: Release notes, tagged source and portal pages directly state the behavior; this is source inspection, not runtime testing.

faq.reason: Common support topic with a short answer that every cited source supports.
